displayName: Find who in your network can intro you to target accounts
summary: Turn a prospect list into a warm intro map using your existing network.

useCases.title: Find who in your network can intro you to target accounts
useCases.message: Help me map warm intro paths to a list of target companies. Ask me where the list is: a Google Sheet, Notion doc, or paste it here. Then cross-reference each company against my LinkedIn connections and identify who in my network has a first or second-degree connection there. Format the results so I know who to approach for an intro to each account.
